Reference rhythm intervals from WFDB rhythm annotations

wfdb_rhythm_intervals.Rd

Converts rhythm annotations (symbol == "+" with an aux label such as "(AFIB") into half-open reference intervals. Each label holds until the next rhythm annotation, and the last one holds until end_sample.

Usage

wfdb_rhythm_intervals(ann, record, fs, end_sample, start_sample = 0,
  before_first = "(unlabelled)")

Arguments

ann

Annotations from read_wfdb_ann().

record

Record identifier.

fs

Sampling frequency in Hz.

end_sample

End of the reference period in samples (e.g. the header n_samples). Required: annotation-only records may have no length.

start_sample

Start of the reference period.

before_first

Label for time before the first rhythm annotation.

Details

Time before the first rhythm annotation has no stated rhythm. By default it is labelled "(unlabelled)", which tl_ledger() treats as unknown when passed in unknown; set before_first to a rhythm label to adopt another convention explicitly.

Value

A data frame with record, start, end (seconds), start_sample, end_sample and label.

Examples

atr <- system.file("extdata", "04015.atr", package = "timeledger")
hea <- read_wfdb_header(system.file("extdata", "04015.hea",
                                    package = "timeledger"))
wfdb_rhythm_intervals(read_wfdb_ann(atr), "04015", hea$fs, hea$n_samples)
